casa-faroluz.pitch: The harbor-side hotel with the lighthouse in the window, a short walk from the Costa Encandela gate.
description: Casa Faroluz opened a year after the first park and has been the island's classic place to stay ever since. It is a deluxe hotel of 280 rooms set around a small harbor, close enough to Costa Encandela that you can see El Faro from the upper floors.
Evenings are the point of staying here. Dinner at Keeper's Table, a drink in the Lighthouse Lounge, and the beam passing over the water every few seconds while the park goes quiet next door.
